\[
\begin{align*}

\text{Term 9 (2}^9\text{)} & : 389120 + 389120 = 778240 \\
\text{Term 10 (2}^{10}\text{)} & : 778240 + 778240 = 1556480 \\
\end{align*}
\]

### Step 2: Decompose 1488 into Binary
1488 in binary is \(10111010000_2\), which corresponds to the powers of 2:
- \(2^{10}\), \(2^8\), \(2^7\), \(2^6\), and \(2^4\).

### Step 3: Sum the Corresponding Terms
Add the terms from the table for the identified powers:
\[

\text{Term 6 (2}^6\text{)} & : 97280 \\
\text{Term 4 (2}^4\text{)} & : 24320 \\
\end{align*}
\]

Adding these step-by-step:
\[
\begin{align*}
1556480 + 389120 & = 1945600 \\
1945600 + 194560 & = 2140160 \\
2140160 + 97280 & = 2237440 \\
2237440 + 24320 & = 2261760 \\
\end{align*}
\]

\boxed{2261760}
